summary: This directory provides utilities for performing deep comparisons and generating differences between objects. It focuses on identifying property changes and structural modifications to ensure data consistency or tracking state mutations within the application.
responsibilities: Identify added, removed, or changed property values
Provide diagnostic data regarding object state discrepancies
relationships: The diffing logic relies on deep comparison to identify changes between object states.
Object differences are represented as structured data reflecting property additions, removals, or updates.
designDecisions: Implemented as a stateless utility for pure data processing
Focus on recursive tree traversal to handle nested objects
